name: When is the best time to get a remodeling estimate?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to get a remodeling estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's best to get a remodeling estimate once you have a clear idea of your project's scope, desired finishes, and a realistic budget range. This allows contractors to provide a more accurate bid. If you're planning a major renovation, obtaining estimates several months in advance is advisable, especially in busy markets like the Bay Area, to allow for contractor availability and permit processing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get an estimate when you have a clear project scope and budget. For major renovations, secure bids several months in advance, particularly in busy markets like the Bay Area.
